resampling: One source-component/taxon/spatial crossed draw is shared across all three modules. A failed shared draw is retained as failed and never redrawn. Both 2-degree and 5-degree grids are always reported; neither is selected by observed performance.
synthetic_environment: Generate nine standardized predictors from fixed global plus process-block latent factors and taxon-level means. This exercises moderate within-block and cross-block dependence without reading empirical trait associations. Predictor order and process partition are the frozen source-QC order.
synthetic_nuisance: Generate exact-day calendar harmonics, observation years including a small pre-1980 fraction, positive head-size, nonnegative sharpness and public coordinates; construct the exact frozen 13-column nuisance matrix through analysis.v3.nuisance_design.matrix. Imaging quality may correlate with generated predictors to stress adjustment.
synthetic_responses: Generate three modules with exactly 1, 8 and 4 continuous transformed response coordinates. Coordinates share module/global residual factors, spatial-region effects and correlated taxon random slopes. This validates final estimator dimensionality and joint covariance/rank handling; it does not assert a Gaussian biological model for hue/composition or replace a later realized-design calibration.
truth: Wetting/moisture and radiation blocks are generating-null for within and among in null scenarios. Heat/drying and mechanical blocks contain fixed nonzero coefficients. In scale_difference, radiation has a predeclared nonzero among coefficient with zero within coefficient, making the direct among-minus-within contrast nonzero. Save complete generating coefficients for every module coordinate.

precision_checks: For each scenario and grid, Wilson 95% half-width for outer-dataset familywise false-Holm-rejection rate among generating-null slots must be <=0.025 before stopping for precision.
For each scenario and grid, Wilson 95% half-width for pooled generating-coefficient basic-interval coverage must be <=0.015 before stopping for precision.
admission_checks: For generating-null families, the Wilson 95% upper bound for familywise false-Holm-rejection rate must be <=0.075.
For generating coefficients, the Wilson 95% lower bound for basic-interval coverage must be >=0.90.
Every retained outer dataset must have all 999 planned shared draws and all 36 family slots estimable; failures are reported, never replaced.
sequential_outer_rule.failure_rule: If an admission check fails, calibration fails. Diagnose estimator/design assumptions; do not tune thresholds, delete slots, select a grid or change the synthetic truth to rescue the result.

later_realized_design_gate: Even a successful multicoordinate synthetic calibration cannot authorize ecology alone. After full measurement reconciliation, rerun null/coverage stress tests on each realized module's frozen taxon/environment/nuisance/dependence design with synthetic responses before empirical probabilities are computed.
